metadata.description: Claude Code mods that make the terminal UI look like the Claude desktop app

plugins.name: desk-look
plugins.description: Claude Code mod that redraws the terminal transcript to look like the Code tab of the Claude desktop app: prompt bubbles, markdown tables, mermaid diagrams, folded tool calls, agent cards, GitHub/GitLab PR bar, diff and context panes

plugins.name: desk-asana
plugins.description: Your Asana tasks in a Claude Code side pane (/desk-asana): assigned tasks, workspace search, project tasks by section, details, comments, assignee, fields and status, through the Asana MCP server. Pairs with desk-look

plugins.name: desk-slack
plugins.description: The Slack DMs sent to you as conversations in a Claude Code side pane (/desk-slack): recent messages, replying and notifications, through the Slack MCP server. Pairs with desk-look

plugins.name: desk-plan
plugins.description: Plan approval (ExitPlanMode) in a card above the prompt instead of the full-screen engine dialog, with the plan in desk-look's preview pane: approve, view the plan, or send it back with what to change. Needs desk-look

plugins.name: desk-grant
plugins.description: Helper installed with desk-asana and desk-slack: allows the Asana and Slack calls their side panes make, so they need no allow rules in your settings. Claude's own calls to those tools still get the usual permission check
